 Follow $10K reward offered for man linked to cell tower equipment theft
 WSBTV.com News Staff Sat, November 14, 2026 at 4:07 PM UTC 1 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. $10K reward offered for man linked to cell tower equipment theft South Fulton Police Department The City of South Fulton Police Department is asking for the public's help locating a man who is a person of interest in the theft of telecommunications equipment from a cell phone tower.
 [DOWNLOAD: Free WSB-TV News app for alerts as news breaks ] 
 Police identified the man as Brandon Chambers, 37.
 Police say Chambers is a person of interest in the theft, which happened Nov. 11. He is also wanted as a fugitive from justice in a separate matter.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement AT&T is offering a reward of up to $10,000 for information leading to Chambers' arrest and conviction.

 Anyone who sees Chambers or knows where he may be is asked to call 911 or contact the City of South Fulton Police Department.
 Police warn the public not to approach Chambers or attempt to apprehend him.
